state_machine.purpose: Fresh instance or between scans; no retained batch state.
state_machine.actions: None. Outputs are not initialized or cleared.

state_machine.purpose: Single sampling point for scan inputs.
state_machine.actions: Latch count, array lower bounds, and compute nProcess = clamp(count, 0, min(len(analogValues), len(channels))). Read-only channel configuration and raw analog values are used as sampled for this scan.

state_machine.purpose: Ordinal loop over the first nProcess channels with per-channel priority decisions.
state_machine.actions: For ordinal j: if j >= count or channels[j].enable is FALSE, preserve retVal and outputValue. Else if measuringMode is not 0, 1, or 2, set retVal=16#8001 and preserve outputValue. Else if hiLIM <= loLIM, set retVal=16#8002 and preserve outputValue. Else compute outputValue according to measuringMode and set retVal=0. Never write analogValues or read-only configuration fields.

state_machine.purpose: Unified output assignments committed for this scan.
state_machine.actions: No persistent state. Next invocation re-enters SAMPLE_INPUTS. Skipped, disabled, out-of-count, and error-channel outputValue remain caller-retained.

timer_plan.reset_conditions: No timers are reset or used. FB behavior is scan-combinational and does not depend on elapsed time.

safety: Never modify read-only channel configuration fields: enable, hiLIM, loLIM, bipolar, measuringMode.
Process only ordinal positions j where j < count and j maps to valid indices in both arrays using each array's independent lower bound.
Preserve retVal and outputValue for disabled and out-of-count channels.
Preserve outputValue for enabled channels that return an error status.
Invalid measuringMode has priority over invalid hiLIM/loLIM.
Limit validation hiLIM <= loLIM applies to every enabled channel whose measuringMode is valid, including temperature modes.
operational: Sample count and array bounds once per scan before processing.
Process ordinals in ascending order from 0 to nProcess-1.
Successful enabled conversion sets retVal=0 and writes exactly one outputValue.
Mode 0 uses unipolar raw 0..27648 or bipolar raw -27648..27648 linear scaling; no saturation is applied.
Use local temporary REAL arithmetic before committing outputValue.

outputs.channels[].retVal: Not initialized or cleared by the FB. Caller-sampled value is preserved for disabled, out-of-count, and invalid channels; written only for enabled in-count channels as specified.
outputs.channels[].outputValue: Not initialized or cleared by the FB. Caller-sampled value is preserved for disabled, out-of-count, and invalid channels; overwritten only on successful enabled conversion.

arrays.analogValues: Read-only; never initialized or written by the FB.
arrays.channels configuration fields: Read-only; never initialized or written by the FB.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.actions: Sample count, array lower bounds, and guard values once for the current invocation. No R_TRIG/R_FTRIG or timer-edge behavior is required. Read-only channel configuration and raw analog values are treated as stable sampled inputs for this scan.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.actions: Establish the global guard nProcess = clamp(count, 0, min(len(analogValues), len(channels))). Apply priority rules: disabled/out-of-count preserves outputs; invalid measuringMode returns 16#8001 before limit validation; invalid limits return 16#8002; valid channels return retVal=0. No reset is required; the logical state transitions IDLE -> SAMPLE_INPUTS -> PROCESS_CHANNEL -> BATCH_DONE each scan.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.actions: None. No timer FBs are required. If timers are added later, their unconditional top-level calls belong here outside CASE/IF blocks.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.actions: Single ordinal loop j = 0 to nProcess-1. For each enabled in-count channel, assign channels[lbC+j].retVal and channels[lbC+j].outputValue exactly once according to the stage-2 priority and conversion rules. Preserve all other channel outputs exactly. Never assign analogValues or any read-only channel field.

formal_assertions.formula: G(analogValues = PRE(analogValues) && forall j: channels[j].enable = PRE(channels[j].enable) && channels[j].hiLIM = PRE(channels[j].hiLIM) && channels[j].loLIM = PRE(channels[j].loLIM) && channels[j].bipolar = PRE(channels[j].bipolar) && channels[j].measuringMode = PRE(channels[j].measuringMode))
G(forall j: (!(j < count && channels[j].enable)) -> (channels[j].retVal = PRE(channels[j].retVal) && channels[j].outputValue = PRE(channels[j].outputValue)))

G(forall j: (j < count && channels[j].enable && channels[j].measuringMode != 0 && channels[j].measuringMode != 1 && channels[j].measuringMode != 2) -> (channels[j].retVal = 16#8001 && channels[j].outputValue = PRE(channels[j].outputValue)))

G(forall j: (j < count && channels[j].enable && (channels[j].measuringMode = 0 || channels[j].measuringMode = 1 || channels[j].measuringMode = 2) && channels[j].hiLIM <= channels[j].loLIM) -> (channels[j].retVal = 16#8002 && channels[j].outputValue = PRE(channels[j].outputValue)))

G(forall j: (j < count && channels[j].enable && (channels[j].measuringMode = 0 || channels[j].measuringMode = 1 || channels[j].measuringMode = 2) && channels[j].hiLIM > channels[j].loLIM) -> channels[j].retVal = 0)

G(forall j: (j < count && channels[j].enable && channels[j].measuringMode = 0 && channels[j].hiLIM > channels[j].loLIM) -> channels[j].outputValue = (channels[j].bipolar ? channels[j].loLIM + ((REAL(analogValues[j]) + 27648.0) / 55296.0) * (channels[j].hiLIM - channels[j].loLIM) : channels[j].loLIM + (REAL(analogValues[j]) / 27648.0) * (channels[j].hiLIM - channels[j].loLIM)))
G(forall j: (j < count && channels[j].enable && channels[j].measuringMode = 1 && channels[j].hiLIM > channels[j].loLIM) -> channels[j].outputValue = REAL(analogValues[j]) / 10.0)
G(forall j: (j < count && channels[j].enable && channels[j].measuringMode = 2 && channels[j].hiLIM > channels[j].loLIM) -> channels[j].outputValue = REAL(analogValues[j]) / 100.0)
